testsuite.name: com.pocketshell.core.ssh.SshjTransportThreadGuardTest

testcase.name: re-install on top of an existing ChainedHandler does not double-wrap
predicate rejects non-sshj thread even with TransportException
predicate stops at a reasonable cause chain depth
predicate accepts sshj thread with wrapped SocketException
predicate accepts sshj thread with bare IOException
chained handler routes non-sshj-thread crashes through previous
predicate accepts sshj-Reader thread with SSHException
installIfNecessary chains over the previous default handler
predicate rejects sshj thread with NullPointerException
predicate walks the cause chain for transport exceptions
predicate accepts sshj-Reader thread with TransportException
installed handler swallows sshj-thread transport crashes
chained handler propagates sshj thread NPE through previous
